articles.title: Kansas State vs Alabama score, live updates, highlights
articles.summary: Kansas State and Alabama will meet for a Thanksgiving matchup in the Players Era 16 tournament. Follow along for live updates.
articles.body:
Kansas State basketball will look to bounce back and hope to give fans something to be thankful for when it takes the floor on Thanksgiving night.

The Wildcats will play No. 15 Alabama on Thursday, Nov. 26, at 8 p.m. CT in a Players Era 16 tournament consolation semifinal at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas .

K-State was blown out 101-61 against No. 20 Gonzaga in the first round on Nov. 24, while Alabama lost 68-63 to Baylor right before. The Crimson Tide's 63 points were the fewest they've scored since 2023 .
